1.text: Ndongera nubura amaso, ngiye kubona mbona amagare ane aturuka hagati y'imisozi ibiri, kandi iyo misozi yari imiringa.

2.text: Ku igare rya mbere hari amafarashi y'amagaju, ku rya kabiri hari amafarashi y'imikara.

3.text: Ku igare rya gatatu hari amafarashi y'imyeru, no ku rya kane hari ay'ibigina y'amabara y'ibitanga.

4.text: Maze mbaza marayika twavuganaga nti “Biriya bisobanurwa bite, nyagasani?”

5.text: Marayika aransubiza ati “Biriya ni imiyaga ine yo mu ijuru, ivuye guhagarara imbere y'Umwami nyir'isi yose.

6.text: Ririya gare rikururwa n'amafarashi y'imikara rirajya mu gihugu cy'ikasikazi, ay'imyeru yaje ayakurikiye n'ay'amabara y'ibitanga, arajya mu gihugu cy'ikusi.”

7.text: Ay'amagaju asohotse ashaka kugenda isi yose ayicuraganamo, aravuga ati “Nimusohoke mugende isi yose muyicuraganemo.” Nuko agenda isi yose ayicuraganamo.

8.text: Maze arampamagara arambwira ati “Ariya ajya mu gihugu cy'ikasikazi, yurūye umwuka wanjye w'uburakari nari narakariye igihugu cy'ikasikazi.”

10.text: “Akira amaturo y'abo banyagano, Heludayi na Tobiya na Yedaya, kandi uwo munsi uzajye kwa Yosiya mwene Zefaniya, ni ho bazaba bari bavuye i Babuloni.

11.text: Bazaguhe ifeza n'izahabu ureme amakamba, uyambike Yosuwa mwene Yosadaki umutambyi mukuru.

12.text: Umubwire uti ‘Uwiteka Nyiringabo aravuga ati: Dore umuntu witwa Shami uzumbūra azamera ahantu he, kandi ni we uzubaka urusengero rw'Uwiteka.

13.text: Ni koko ni we uzubaka urusengero rw'Uwiteka, azagira icyubahiro, azicara ku ntebe y'ubwami ategeke, kandi azaba umutambyi ku ntebe ye. Bombi bazahuza inama zizana amahoro.’

14.text: Ayo makamba azaba aya Helemu na Tobiya, na Yedaya na Heni mwene Zefaniya, azaba urwibutso mu rusengero rw'Uwiteka.

15.text: “Kandi abazaba bari kure bazaza bubake mu rusengero rw'Uwiteka, maze muzamenye yuko Uwiteka Nyiringabo ari we wabantumyeho. Ibyo bizasohora nimugira umwete wo kumvira Uwiteka Imana yanyu.”
